assertion_analysis.condition_to_fail: Recorded run or spool discard becomes unreadable to promotion.discard_recorded; this is a fixture precondition using the existing owner.
Removing settled checks from either route recreates a live pointer and resumes the worker for a discarded delivery; the base capture shows the pointer assertion fail.
Returning an unrelated refusal drops the discarded disposition, or the new code deletes the discard marker.
Fixture merge does not actually integrate the reviewed head; precondition is checked independently by Git ancestry.
Reinstating base behavior recreates the pointer, leaves the stale pending record, resumes the worker, or omits the already-landed disposition.
Fixture local merge is absent or the fixture accidentally pushes that merge; independent local and remote Git ancestry establish the outstanding-push control.

Restoring the first commit local-only ancestry check returns already-landed and deletes the pending record; resumed==[] alone is weak because the helper itself never resumes, but the disposition and file-existence assertions detect this regression.
Fixture lacks an actual result.txt conflict, the head is already integrated, or a discard exists; these are independently verified route preconditions.
The guard incorrectly settles a genuine conflict, pointer marking omits pending_landing_repair, the receipt fails to reach resumed, or the worker is resumed zero or multiple times.

The advice omits the actual head or primary, or the repair wrongly removes its pending record; head and primary are input-propagation assertions and do fail if the advice stops carrying either value, while conflict correctness is established separately by merge-tree.

failure_evidence.derivation: Read completed gate logs, verified EXIT and revision, and subtracted baseline FAILED ids from head FAILED ids; both sets empty. Independently checked importer logs carry the same one failing ID.

findings.text: blocking: The new settled receipt contains status, reason and head but no advice; queue_landing.py:1935 passes its result to repair["advice"] at :1950, so a discarded live run with a conflicting head raises KeyError and aborts the landing pass instead of producing a refusal; preserve the receipt contract or teach the caller to handle settled results and cover that production path.

blocking: For a pending record whose head is already remote-landed and whose original marked pointer still exists, _settled_landing clears the pending record and this branch returns before _release_marked_pointer and release_landed_worktrees at :390-397; queue_landing.py:1735 then skips the surviving pending_landing_repair pointer every pass and no pending record remains to finish it; retain attempt-aware cleanup for a settled original pointer while preserving any newer attempt.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commits 54a5556de751cdf51ad542ffc3a11a4b99265969 and 6848e56f38156f5361c089414d3f6ebf9d544b06 against base 75d29d701cf46aa19ff26734793c777b419f8ebc; the shared guard reuses existing owners but adds two unsafe early-return interactions.
item_verdicts.done_when: Read prompt.txt:125-126 against base-armed.log, final-armed.log, negative-control.log and importer logs; the specified cases pass at head, eight fail at base, and importer failure IDs add none.
item_verdicts.goal: Read prompt.txt:38 and live plan s10; pending_landing.py:84 and recovery_repair_dispatch.py:53 stop absent-pointer resurrection, but the settled return strands existing marked pointers.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read manifest.md and its linked receipts; the 62-pass focused gate, zero-added importer failures and three coordinator reconciliation actions agree with the recorded artifacts.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read prompt.txt:80-85; all four paths in the base-to-head diff are declared, and the worker made no operational pending-record changes.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_discarded_run_stays_discarded.py:94 and :132 fail when settled guards are removed, but its absent-pointer fixture at :45-72 never covers an existing marked pointer or queue_landing.py:1950 consuming the refusal receipt.
justifications.evidence: final-armed.log records 62 passed and EXIT=0 at the reviewed head, negative-control.log records eight base failures, and base-importers.log/final-importers.log record the same single failure.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:57 breaks the advice-bearing receipt consumed at queue_landing.py:1950, and pending_landing.py:285 skips the module's attempt-aware cleanup at :390-397.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:53 prevents both recorded forms of resurrection, while reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:285 abandons completion of an existing marked attempt.
justifications.reuse: Capability searches for discard detection, remote ancestry and pending repair found promotion.py:2104 and merge.py:747, which pending_landing.py:84 wraps in the existing pending-landing owner; new test helpers reuse tests/helpers/git.py rather than duplicating Git execution.
justifications.scope_discipline: The four changed paths from git diff are all listed in prompt.txt:80-85 and the evidence fragment records the requested inventory without changing live state.
